summary.intent: Drive a multi-trail effort to improve the accuracy of Caliper's component prop output (collapse rules, checker backend bugs, release pipeline), and now investigate code-review and slop-review findings on trail 172 to understand patterns and reduce low-quality output.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #321-#324 (crate-wide missing_docs, ADR notes, weekly headline, layer-only investigation), got approval for a collapse-by-relevance rule and launched workers for trails 192 and 164, and diagnosed why the 0.9.0 GitHub Release backfill cannot succeed. Started collecting agent-review findings across trails, but the analysis was not completed in this transcript.

repo: Collapsing inherited props by size (30-prop threshold) is the wrong rule: on antd 664 of 669 layer-only props are real API, on shadcn 6,507 of 6,774 are ambient (react-aria GlobalDOMEvents). 36% (antd) and 30% (shadcn) of API props sit in 31-40 prop layers and lose types.

Proposed relevance rule classifies a dependency source as ambient by DOM file, DOM type name, style type name, or global attribute name, regardless of size; measured net output +4.6% antd, -2.2% shadcn, vs +4.8%/+9.7% for expanding everything. The size rule exists for Chakra-scale corpora (560 to 398,910 props), unmeasured under the new rule.

The release backfill pinned via RELEASE_PENDING_FROM selects 2daef927 (the 0.9.0 merge of #269), which predates the [release] section in callisto.toml, so Callisto plans zero artifact slots, execute is a no-op (all outcomes alreadySatisfied), and the assemble job is skipped because has_artifacts is false.

0.9.0 stays pending forever, so every push to main re-selects it, re-runs a full build, and blocks real releases (like #291) from getting an immediate run; they would only run via the drain job or daily schedule. docs/releasing.md (~line 60) wrongly assumes the backfill creates the 0.9.0 Release.
Shared helpers normComponent and pathKey live in tool-universe.ts; duplicate copies in the oracle reference code were removed during the #318 merge fix.
The stray `tw` props in the corpus come from next's @vercel/og HTMLAttributes, a second HTMLAttributes interface.
The 'API props in 31-40 band' counter actually counts layers of 40 props or fewer; correct only because all collapsed layers exceed 30.
Local headline: shadcn is 54.4% correct, 0.06% wrong (0.096% of judged props, just under the 0.1% alert gate), with 39.6% named-only through a collapsed layer; antd is 83.7% correct, 0.00% wrong.

code.finding: Assumes the backfill rebuilds 0.9.0 and creates its GitHub Release, which is false for a release commit that predates the [release] config.
Classifier with ordered clauses (dom file, dom type, style type, global attribute => ambient; otherwise API), reading only the layer's file, type name and prop name.
One paragraph remains stale after the ADR 0006/0007 change (sessions clear checker answers per revision instead of notifying tsc); deferred to a follow-up.

friction: The trail review page required a login, forcing a fallback to the CLI.
The CLI finding fields did not match the guessed names, requiring a raw JSON dump to discover the structure.
The local callisto binary rejects the `release` subcommand, so the fix for the pending check could not be verified.
Earlier assurance that the 0.9.0 backfill would work was wrong and baked into docs and the #288 recovery design.
Chakra, Mantine and Spectrum are not installed locally, so the relevance rule is unvalidated at scale.
The release-diagnose report was truncated mid-sentence.
open_items: Analyze the agent-review/slop-review findings on trail 172 change 115 (#318) and across all trails for patterns, and look for similar issues elsewhere.
Fix the release backfill (move or remove the RELEASE_PENDING_FROM pin or hand-create the 0.9.0 release), correct docs/releasing.md, and do not merge #291 until settled.
Merge #318, then retarget #324 to main; merge the rest of #320-#323 and #291 after review.
Complete trail 192 (collapse by relevance, all five corpora, Chakra first-load budget gate) and trail 164 (checker lost optional/rest markers, extra underscore on __size).
Unstarted: less-precise type fixes (unexpanded names, Form.watch as empty object, optional function losing | undefined).
Fix the stale paragraph in docs/type-checker-integration.md; add per-component invalidation and a session-versus-extract() parity test.
Open decisions: trail 156 ADR (lean skip), trail 154 follow-up for dependency-loading cost, pinning macos-26 in the release matrix.
Watch the first CI weekly run on #323, where Spectrum's 1.09% wrong rate will likely trip the gate.
